f3_program: collection("colton.dolphin_stickers", "dolphin_sticker", "colton", source("72 dolphin stickers"))
observe(at("colton.dolphin_stickers.count", "initial"), 72, "count", source("Colton had 72 dolphin stickers"))
collection("colton.first_friend_group", "friend", "colton", source("3 friends"))
observe(at("colton.first_friend_group.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("3 friends"))
observe(at("colton.gifts.first_friend_group.each.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("4 stickers each"))

product_relation("colton.gifts.first_friend_group.total.count", at("colton.gifts.first_friend_group.each.count", "current"), at("colton.first_friend_group.count", "current"), source("4 stickers each to 3 friends"))

transfer("give_first_friend_group", "colton", at("colton.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), at("colton.first_friend_group.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), "colton.gifts.first_friend_group.total.count", source("He gave 4 stickers each to 3 friends"))
offset("colton.gifts.mandy.count", event_field("give_first_friend_group", "quantity"), 2, "count", source("2 more than he gave his three friends total"))

transfer("give_mandy", "colton", at("colton.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), at("mandy.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), "colton.gifts.mandy.count", source("He also gave his friend Mandy 2 more than he gave his three friends total"))
offset("colton.gifts.justin.count", event_field("give_mandy", "quantity"), -10, "count", source("10 less than Mandy"))

transfer("give_justin", "colton", at("colton.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), at("justin.dolphin_stickers.count", "current"), "colton.gifts.justin.count", source("he gave Justin 10 less than Mandy"))
query("remaining_count", "colton.dolphin_stickers", "current")
assumptions: The gifts to Mandy and Justin are additional to the gifts to the three unnamed friends.

f3_program: observe(at("nigella.base_salary", "month"), 3000, "dollar", source("base salary of $3,000 a month"))
collection("nigella.sold_houses", "house", "nigella", source("Nigella sells 3 houses"))
observe(at("nigella.sold_houses.count", "month"), 3, "count", source("Nigella sells 3 houses"))
percent_of(at("nigella.sold_houses.each.commission", "month"), at("nigella.sold_houses.each.cost", "month"), 2, source("2% commission on every house she sells"))

sum_relation(at("nigella.earnings.total", "month"), at("nigella.base_salary", "month"), at("nigella.sold_houses.commission.total", "month"), source("earns a base salary of $3,000 a month plus a 2% commission on every house she sells"))
observe(at("nigella.earnings.total", "month"), 8000, "dollar", source("earns $8,000 total"))
member("nigella.sold_houses", "nigella.sold_houses.house_a", source("House B costs three times as much as House A"))
member("nigella.sold_houses", "nigella.sold_houses.house_b", source("House B costs three times as much as House A"))
member("nigella.sold_houses", "nigella.sold_houses.house_c", source("House C cost twice as much as House A minus $110,000"))
multiple(at("nigella.sold_houses.house_b.cost", "month"), at("nigella.sold_houses.house_a.cost", "month"), 3, source("House B costs three times as much as House A"))
offset(at("nigella.sold_houses.house_c.cost", "month"), scale(at("nigella.sold_houses.house_a.cost", "month"), 2), -110000, "dollar", source("House C cost twice as much as House A minus $110,000"))
query("value", at("nigella.sold_houses.house_a.cost", "month"))
assumptions: Houses A, B, and C are the three houses sold in the stated month.
The House C clause means twice House A's cost, followed by a subtraction of $110,000.

f3_program: collection("john.daily_meals", "meal", "john", source("3 meals a day"))
observe(at("john.daily_meals.count", "day"), 3, "count", source("John eats 3 meals a day"))
member("john.daily_meals", "john.daily_meals.breakfast", source("Breakfast is 500 calories"))
observe(at("john.daily_meals.breakfast.calories", "day"), 500, "calorie", source("Breakfast is 500 calories"))
member("john.daily_meals", "john.daily_meals.lunch", source("His lunch contains 25% more calories than that"))
percent_more(at("john.daily_meals.lunch.calories", "day"), at("john.daily_meals.breakfast.calories", "day"), 25, source("His lunch contains 25% more calories than that"))
member("john.daily_meals", "john.daily_meals.dinner", source("His dinner is twice as many calories as lunch"))
multiple(at("john.daily_meals.dinner.calories", "day"), at("john.daily_meals.lunch.calories", "day"), 2, source("His dinner is twice as many calories as lunch"))
collection("john.daily_shakes", "shake", "john", source("3 shakes"))
observe(at("john.daily_shakes.count", "day"), 3, "count", source("3 shakes"))
observe(at("john.daily_shakes.each.calories", "day"), 300, "calorie", source("each 300 calories"))
product_relation(at("john.daily_shakes.calories.total", "day"), at("john.daily_shakes.count", "day"), at("john.daily_shakes.each.calories", "day"), source("3 shakes that are each 300 calories"))
query("value", at("john.calorie_intake.total", "day"))
assumptions: Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are the three daily meals, and the three shakes are additional daily intake.

f3_program: collection("kylie.class.students", "student", "kylie.class", source("students in Kylie's class"))
observe(at("kylie.class.students.count", "current"), 50, "count", source("The number of students in Kylie's class is 50"))

collection("kylie.class.test_score_groups", "student_group", "kylie.class.students", source("ten students scored 90 marks, 15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students, and the rest scored 60 marks each"))
member("kylie.class.test_score_groups", "kylie.class.test_score_groups.first", source("ten students scored 90 marks"))
member("kylie.class.test_score_groups", "kylie.class.test_score_groups.second", source("15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students"))
member("kylie.class.test_score_groups", "kylie.class.test_score_groups.remaining", source("the rest scored 60 marks each"))

partition("kylie.class.test_score_groups", at("kylie.class.students.count", "current"), source("ten students scored 90 marks, 15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students, and the rest scored 60 marks each"))
observe(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.first.students.count", "particular_test"), 10, "count", source("ten students"))
observe(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.first.score", "particular_test"), 90, "mark", source("ten students scored 90 marks"))
observe(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.second.students.count", "particular_test"), 15, "count", source("15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students"))

offset(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.second.score", "particular_test"), at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.first.score", "particular_test"), -10, "mark", source("15 scored ten marks fewer than the first ten students"))
observe(at("kylie.class.test_score_groups.remaining.score", "particular_test"), 60, "mark", source("the rest scored 60 marks each"))
query("mean", at("kylie.class.students.test_score", "particular_test"))
collection("sister.party.balloons", "balloon", "sister.party", source("balloons for her sister’s party"))
observe(at("kris.balloon_inflation.duration", "work_period"), 30, "minute", source("She has 30 minutes to blow up as many balloons as possible"))
observe(at("kris.balloon_inflation.rate", "work_period"), 2, "balloon_per_minute", source("Kris can blow up a total of 2 balloon per minute"))
multiple(at("kris.brother.balloon_inflation.rate", "first_15_minutes"), at("kris.balloon_inflation.rate", "work_period"), 2, source("her brother works twice as fast"))
observe(at("kris.brother.balloon_inflation.duration", "first_15_minutes"), 15, "minute", source("After 15 minutes"))
multiple(at("kris.brother.balloon_inflation.rate", "remaining_15_minutes"), at("kris.brother.balloon_inflation.rate", "first_15_minutes"), 2, source("her brother doubles his speed"))
observe(at("kris.brother.balloon_inflation.duration", "remaining_15_minutes"), 15, "minute", source("remaining 15 minutes"))
produce("kris_work_period", "kris", at("sister.party.balloons.blown_up.count", "current"), "kris.balloon_production.count", source("Kris is blowing u balloons for her sister’s party"))

rate_relation("kris.balloon_production.count", at("kris.balloon_inflation.rate", "work_period"), at("kris.balloon_inflation.duration", "work_period"), source("She has 30 minutes to blow up as many balloons as possible and decides to enlist her brother’s help to increase the number of balloons. Kris can blow up a total of 2 balloon per minute"))

produce("brother_first_period", "kris.brother", at("sister.party.balloons.blown_up.count", "current"), "kris.brother.balloon_production.first_period.count", source("decides to enlist her brother’s help to increase the number of balloons"))

rate_relation("kris.brother.balloon_production.first_period.count", at("kris.brother.balloon_inflation.rate", "first_15_minutes"), at("kris.brother.balloon_inflation.duration", "first_15_minutes"), source("her brother works twice as fast. After 15 minutes, her brother doubles his speed"))

produce("brother_remaining_period", "kris.brother", at("sister.party.balloons.blown_up.count", "current"), "kris.brother.balloon_production.remaining_period.count", source("works at this new speed for the remaining 15 minutes"))

rate_relation("kris.brother.balloon_production.remaining_period.count", at("kris.brother.balloon_inflation.rate", "remaining_15_minutes"), at("kris.brother.balloon_inflation.duration", "remaining_15_minutes"), source("works at this new speed for the remaining 15 minutes"))
query("value", at("sister.party.balloons.blown_up.count", "after_30_minutes"))
assumptions: Kris works at her stated rate for all 30 minutes; her brother works at his initial rate for the first 15 minutes and at his doubled rate for the remaining 15 minutes.
